title.zh: Tether and Fasanara Capital Launch $400 Million Private Credit Fund to Expand Stablecoin-Enabled Real-Economy Lending
title.en: Tether and Fasanara Capital Launch $400 Million Private Credit Fund to Expand Stablecoin-Enabled Real-Economy Lending

current_state.zh: Tether和Fasanara Capital推出了4000万美元的私人信贷基金StableFund，目标募集高达30亿美元，面向60多个国家的资产支持贷款，使用USDT作为结算基础设施，重点关注中小企业和消费贷款领域。
current_state.en: Tether and Fasanara Capital have launched a $400 million private credit fund, StableFund, targeting up to $3 billion, for asset-backed lending in over 60 countries, using USDT as settlement infrastructure, focusing on SME and consumer lending.

updates.title_zh: Tether, Fasanara launch $400M private credit fund targeting $3B
updates.title_en: Tether, Fasanara launch $400M private credit fund targeting $3B
updates.what_changed_zh: 该基金目标从机构投资者募集高达30亿美元，名为StableFund，采用永久资本结构，由Fasanara负责投资管理，Tether负责提供USDT结算基础设施并挖掘相关融资机会，重点关注中小企业和消费贷款，包括贸易应收款和供应链金融。
updates.what_changed_en: The fund aims to raise up to $3 billion from institutional investors, named StableFund, structured as an evergreen fund, with Fasanara managing investments and Tether providing USDT settlement infrastructure and sourcing financing opportunities, focusing on SME and consumer lending including trade receivables and supply chain finance.
